mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals weak consumer spending power, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST < 650 and RSAFS < 400000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 95.0 (INDPRO) during post-recession recovery indicates strengthening manufacturing output, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of post-recession recovery periods when INDPRO > 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to rising real interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS > 132000) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < 8.0%) indicate robust labor market conditions, fueling positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 132000 and UNRATE < 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate increases above 1.0% during monetary tightening cycles compress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%.
